detail.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash small-batch decode fusions (fused all-reduce + mHC epilogues, the fused inverse-RoPE + WO-A + MXFP8 kernel, and SM100 swap-AB decode attention) were gated to TP4 shapes (tp_size == 4, 2 local o_groups, 16 local heads). TP2 decode therefore ran the unfused path at every batch size, although TP2 is the better latency/throughput point for this model on GB300 at mid concurrency.

## Modifications

- Fused all-reduce + mHC: admit tp_size 2 (the all-reduce kernels are already templated on world size).
- Fused WO-A: take the local group count (2 at TP4, 4 at TP2) as a template parameter.
- Swap-AB decode attention: run TP2's 32 local heads as two 16-head groups on the partial kernel's grid z axis.
- Tests: WO-A fused test parametrized over 2 and 4 groups; swap-AB test covers 32 heads.

The gates check shapes (16 or 32 local heads, 2 or 4 local o_groups, tp_size 2 or 4), not TP size alone, so any deployment with those local shapes takes these paths; only DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP2 and TP4 have been validated.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP2 on GB300:

| setting | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| 1 thread | 0.968 | 0.967 |
| 64 threads | 0.970 | 0.973 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash FP4, MTP, TP2 on GB300, AgentX trace replay, 1 h per point (P90 tok/s/user @ output tok/s/GPU):

| conc | main | this PR | P90 | tput/GPU |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 431.7 @ 12,443 | 517.7 @ 13,423 | +19.9% | +7.9% |
| 2 | 392.6 @ 12,689 | 439.6 @ 13,865 | +12.0% | +9.3% |
| 4 | 383.5 @ 18,119 | 417.5 @ 18,495 | +8.9% | +2.1% |
| 16 | 264.6 @ 55,560 | 292.6 @ 56,590 | +10.6% | +1.9% |
| 32 | 183.1 @ 113,613 | 189.0 @ 115,634 | +3.2% | +1.8% |

Unit tests on GB300: test_wo_a_fused.py and test_swapab_attention.py pass.

Co-authored-by: @nbommi19

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
